reviewer_statement: Developer-scoped native R scientific Matplotlib input/artist-array geometry on supported FPCA source records. Direct frozen Python 1.2 plotting comparisons and three-OS CI are committed but not observed passing exact-head. No runtime Matplotlib Axes parity or independent scientific certification is asserted.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native FPCA source-scientific plot artist captures original numerical data, source-selected indices, source axis labels, artist settings and source uncertainty geometry. Rendering and exceptions belong to native R and cannot be equated to Matplotlib figures or full Python API return types.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 public src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_fpca_stability. Source-scientific native strict mode is explicitly optional.

Actual native bootstrap FPCA stability scientific result with finite n_bootstrap×n_reference_FPC matched absolute similarity matrix bounded 0..1 and reference n_components. Python Source allows Matplotlib ax injection but native R base graphics only accepts native result and drawing device; arbitrary Python object protocol remains out-of-scope.

Native scientific source record preserves the exact original matched FPCA bootstrap similarity for every retained reference component, source 0..1.02 y-limits, per-component FPCk labels, NumPy linear interpolation 25/50/75 percentiles, source 1.5 IQR whiskers and explicit outlier values. Pinned Python 1.2 public Matplotlib ax.boxplot artist medians and titles compared directly to same native matrix, plus offline native scientific tests; exact-head CI not yet observed green.

Refuses unsupported class, malformed finite/similarity bounds or component matrix, absent reference n_components and nonlogical strict flag, without silently clipping true outliers. Python TypeError and live Axes exceptions are not replicated by R native graphics.

Python returns one Matplotlib Axes with per-FPC boxplots. Native R returns one scientific source-geometry record with full replicate vectors, exact quartile/whisker values, labels and y-range, and also draws a base-R boxplot. Pixel-identical Matplotlib boxes and Python axes identity are explicitly not represented.

Bootstrap distribution of absolute matched functional principal-component similarities to reference FPCA components, preserving the actual resampling source without generating new bootstrap results or inferring coverage.

independent_review_status: Developer source-scientific geometry review; exact-head native/Python test run not yet confirmed green, no independent reviewer signed off.
language_specific_limits: R base graphics device and typed R data cannot return Python Matplotlib Axes, artist object protocols, figure events or pixel-identical boxplots/errorbars.
No end-to-end bootstrap/random-replication parity is asserted beyond native scientific source arrays used as plotting inputs.
Python exception classes, dtype/protocol acceptance and optional ax injection remain outside bounded source geometry review.
Zero independent source-contract certification remains; no promise of merged branch or CRAN readiness.
